summary: community.postgresql deprecated postgresql_lang, to be removed in 4.0.0; use postgresql_ext instead.
questions: How do I install plpgsql or another language with Ansible?

answer_card.title: postgresql_lang → postgresql_ext
answer_card.answer_md: `postgresql_lang` is deprecated (removal in **community.postgresql 4.0.0**). Manage procedural languages as extensions with **`community.postgresql.postgresql_ext`**.
